notes: No misreadings found. Three points for a human reviewer. (1) /configuration/3 recommends ic_info for pending, and /configuration/4 and /examples/1 use ic_close for failed. These follow the published stories. The guide's Sources section and the evidence both say Biscuit's newer, unpublished page suggests ic_warning and ic_error instead, and the entry does not carry that caveat. (2) /states/3 adds 'with no body and showDetails off'. The cited sentence does not say this, but the states description supports it ('The body appears only when you set it, and showDetails turns the details off'). An empty details string would also work. (3) /examples/2 uses VStack and Button props that the guide does not show. The evidence says the in-context screen is a ScreenFrame with a full-width Done button. Check this against the package rather than the guide.
